people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.
translations.bsb: Therefore, since you have been raised with Christ, strive for the things above, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.
translations.kjv: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.
translations.asv: If then ye were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.
